entries.5bf676aee353b2b6: The company is a holding company headquartered in Minato-ku, Tokyo, and is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Growth Market. Through a newly established company split in January 2025, it transitioned to a holding company structure, and the company and three consolidated subsidiaries form the group. As of September 30, 2025, the number of consolidated employees was 59.

entries.8b4f9200e9d19ebf: The company provides executive coaching for corporate top executives and management executives, business leader / businessperson coaching that provides coaching online 1 time per month, and business coaching programs that enable managers to conduct 1on1 meetings effectively. It also provides a cloud coaching system that supports records of behavioral change goals and execution.

entries.b20dfc05a92fc1b6: Under its purpose of "enabling the sustainable development of a society in which working people feel happiness by supporting the expression of each individual's diverse appeal, aspirations and abilities," the group positions the Talent Development Business as its core area and its policy is to concentrate management resources in that area.
entries.bb03c06a7b04dfd9: This is the main business of the company and its three consolidated subsidiaries. For corporate clients, mainly management and middle management, it offers coaching services that support behavioral change and organizational capability improvement through business coaching, as well as human resources and organizational support services that underpin the practice of human capital management. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥1,587 million.
entries.d3bdb74ba0b23f6a: It is a business model in which, through 3 consolidated subsidiaries, it provides human resources and organizational support services, including 1-on-1 coaching for executives, programs for managers and assessments, to corporate clients and earns fees for the services provided.
entries.d409f76cd2249aab: The core Business Coaching service is delivered across all areas of business, using an approach that draws out the maximum potential of each individual, from executives to new employees. It provides one-on-one services such as executive coaching and business leader / business person coaching, as well as HR and organizational support services such as training and assessments.
entries.e5c786d30f426ea9: Under its purpose of "enabling the sustainable development of a society in which working people feel happiness by supporting the expression of each individual's diverse appeal, aspirations and abilities," the group positions the Talent Development Business as its core area and its policy is to concentrate management resources in that area. Positioning itself as a "producer of human capital management," it aims to strengthen a structure that provides one-stop solutions to HR and organizational issues centered on coaching, and through a capital and business alliance with Nihon Keizai Shimbun, Inc. in November 2025, it aims to accelerate the social spread of human capital management and the creation of "execution talent."
